name: Chernovite
iocPatterns: Remote HTTP calls for PLC configuration changes
Execution of SDelete or similar file-wiping binaries
Manipulation of Modbus/OPC UA traffic", "Large-scale automated deletion of files in system directories
keyCapabilities: Development of modular ICS attack frameworks (PIPEDREAM)
Wiping PLC memory and resetting hardware configurations
Execution of a wide range of industrial-specific techniques via specialized toolkits
Manipulation of industrial protocols including Modbus and OPC UA
Remote exploitation of device operating modes via HTTP services
Support for heterogeneous PLC hardware (Omron, Schneider Electric, CoDeSyS)
Deployment of dedicated modules for lateral movement and data destruction
Exploitation of native functionality to bypass traditional security controls
recommendedActions: Implement strict network segmentation between IT and OT environments.
Monitor for unauthorized or unusual industrial protocol traffic (Modbus, OPC UA).
Alert on the use of file shredding tools like SDelete within the ICS environment.
Conduct periodic audits of PLC memory configurations to detect unauthorized changes.
Restrict all remote HTTP access to devices managing critical infrastructure components.
Implement a whitelist-based policy for firmware updates and logic changes.
Deploy IDS/IPS specifically tuned for industrial protocol manipulation.
Harden system accounts by limiting permissions for service accounts interacting with PLCs.
campaignsText: Chernovite has been active since 2021 and shows a consistent focus on infrastructure sabotage. They demonstrate an advanced preparation phase, building modular tools like PIPEDREAM that allow them to target various industrial hardware brands with different protocols simultaneously. Their operational tempo suggests high sophistication, moving from general reconnaissance to targeted ICS-specific destruction in critical sectors such as electricity and gas.
description: Chernovite is a sophisticated threat actor specializing in the destruction and disruption of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and SCADA infrastructure. Utilizing the modular PIPEDREAM framework, the group targets critical sectors including energy, manufacturing, and utilities to compromise physical processes.
goals: Chernovite's primary objectives are the degradation and disruption of industrial processes. They specifically target sectors vital to national stability and safety, including energyed (electric and gas), manufacturing, oil and gas, mining, and water treatment. The goal is not mere data theft but rather high-impact sabotage that affects physical reliability.
